description: Note Taker is a local macOS desktop app that turns highlights from books into a personal, git-backed knowledge base. The user photographs yellow-highlighted pages of physical books (or pastes Kindle highlight text), drops a batch of photos into an Electron app, reviews and edits drafts extracted by a configurable OCR (Tesseract) or local vision model (Ollama), and pushes approved highlights as markdown sections appended to one file per book (`books/<slug>.md`) in a GitHub repo they own, so they can recall a book's takeaways and apply them at work.

features.name: Ollama vision extractor
features.evidence: Commits 1c52a7e (extractor), 8f5943d (qwen2.5vl:7b default + num_ctx=8192), 41bb72a (truncation -> ExtractionError, Pass 2 close) and f032f17 (README env wording, env whitespace strip, truncation warning log). tests/test_ollama_extractor.py with respx (request body, schema without bbox, timeouts, error mapping). Ollama live validation Pass 1: live p163 test green on the default qwen2.5vl:7b with options.num_ctx=8192 (Ollama's 4096 default truncated the JSON, done_reason=length); live fixture report ran on all local photos without ExtractionError. Schema (nullable unions) unchanged: the server accepted it. Candidates qwen2.5vl:3b (page=None) and granite3.2-vision (timeout, no match) failed p163. Pass 2 (2026-11-21): no prompt change; done_reason=length now raises ExtractionError (unit-tested, 24 non-live tests pass). Live suite re-run on qwen2.5vl:7b: 2 passed in 382.68s; all 9 fixtures returned highlights, page=None on 3/9 and one note that repeats highlight text (residuals in docs/deferred-findings.md; the user corrects them in the review editor). ~40-55s per photo. Live tests stay deselected by default.

features.name: Review UI: live state, discard, numbering, page, save errors, settings focus
features.evidence: Commits dd92c00, 01c9b12. SSE onState, Discard reload, numbering, page message, 409/422 copy, Cmd+Enter guard, Settings 422 focus, silenced stderr. Client reports live / reconnecting / closed through onState; BatchList a failed delete reloads the list and keeps the error visible; BatchGrid numbers thumbnails among reviewable-set captures, skipping hidden pushed ones; ReviewEditor flags "12a" at once, keeps the text, and never sends it; 409 batch_pushing: paused text only, no alert, no button, no retry timer; ReviewEditorSafety ignores isComposing without touching the event; Settings flags each mapped field, focuses the first in form order, and counts them in the alert; frontend/tests/backend.test.ts silences process.stderr.write in the ring-buffer test.
